name: Create a custom environment for the current project.
description: Create a custom environment for the current project. Creates a custom environment for the current project. POST /v9/projects/{idOrName}/custom-environments
context:
POST /v9/projects/{idOrName}/custom-environments
Creates a custom environment for the current project. Cannot be named 'Production' or 'Preview'.
Required: idOrName (path) — The unique project identifier or the project name
Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.; body (body)

name: Retrieve a custom environment

context:
GET /v9/projects/{idOrName}/custom-environments/{environmentSlugOrId}
Retrieve a custom environment for the project. Must not be named 'Production' or 'Preview'.
Required: idOrName (path) — The unique project identifier or the project name; environmentSlugOrId (path) — The unique custom environment identifier within the project
Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.
